messages.author: bcb52a2d8001a6d1
messages.subject: scales='free'
parts:
ggplotters,

I must be doing something silly.  I can't get the two scales in a facet plot to scale independently.  Help please!

Troy
coeffsum <- data.frame(ty=factor(c('a','a','a','a','b','b','b','b')),
est=c(-3,-4,-.1,-.05,-3,-4,-.1,-.05), c=factor(c('a','a','b','b','a','a','b','b')))
print(ggplot(coeffsum, aes(ty, est))
+ facet_grid(. ~ c, scales="free") + geom_point())

Hi:

Will this do?

ggplot(coeffsum, aes(ty, est)) + geom_point() +
   facet_grid(c ~ ., scales="free")

HTH,
Dennis

messages.author: 539623a2f30c9e53
messages.subject: Re: scales='free'
parts:
Alternatively, if you still want the plots side-by-side:

ggplot(coeffsum, aes(ty, est))+
  facet_wrap( ~ c, scales="free") +
  geom_point()

facet_grid requires that adjacent plots have the same scale on one dimension, as it only creates one axis per row or column. facet_wrap does not, as it creates axes for each graph.

Jonathan
